subtitle: Hibiscus agua fresca
verso: Agua de jamaica, red and icy cold: the one you sip all day long.
story: Deep red hibiscus water, tart and cold. A jug of agua fresca sits on the table at the big midday meal.

ingredients.title: Agua fresca
items: ½–¾ cup sugar or grated piloncillo

steps: Boil [[4 cups]] of the water with the flowers and cinnamon 5 minutes. Turn off the heat and steep 15 minutes.
Strain, pressing on the flowers. Stir in the sugar while it's warm.
Add the remaining [[4 cups]] of cold water. Taste and adjust. Serve over ice.
pressureNote: No pressure-cooker version needed. It's a quick steep.
tips: The flowers make a second, lighter batch. Or sauté them with onion and garlic for tacos de jamaica.

variations.name: Horchata de Arroz
variations.subtitle: Rice and cinnamon horchata
variations.note: Mexican horchata is made from rice and cinnamon.

items: ½ cup milk or evaporated milk, optional

steps: Soak the rice and cinnamon in [[4 cups]] hot water overnight.
Blend the rice, cinnamon and soaking water 2 minutes until very fine.
Strain through a cloth or a very fine strainer.
Add the remaining water, the sugar, vanilla and milk. Serve over ice, stirring before you pour because it settles.
